storage: volume JSONL <archive>/clinical_trials/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl(.gz) = CHANGE events only; full latest snapshot in <archive>/clinical_trials/_state.json.gz (atomic write)
source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies), keyless. Window: industry-sponsored (LeadSponsorClass=INDUSTRY) interventional Phase 2/3 trials whose primary completion date falls in [today-60d, today+365d]; ~3,200 trials, 4 pages/cycle. Fields verified live 2026-10-19.
license: ClinicalTrials.gov data is US-government public domain (NLM terms: no restriction on use; attribution to the source requested, no implied NLM endorsement). Product-surfaceable with attribution.

field_map.t: bootstrap (first snapshot marker, no changes claimed) | new (registered within 14d) | entered_window (older trial whose primary completion date rolled into the forward edge of the window) | pcd_shift (sponsor changed the primary completion date) | status (overall-status change, e.g. RECRUITING>TERMINATED) | left_window (no longer in the window: completed, date moved out, or removed — cause NOT inferred)
field_map.key: dedup key: pcd_shift/status = type|nct|old>new (unique per transition); others type|nct|rt
field_map.sponsor: lead sponsor name (as registered; NOT mapped to a ticker yet)
field_map.shiftDays: pcd - prevPcd in days; + = delayed, - = pulled forward
field_map.coarse: true when either date was month-only in the registry (normalised to the 1st) — shifts under ~31 days are NOT resolvable then
field_map.title: brief title (120)
field_map.rt: as-seen UTC date (the only knowledge-date we claim; the registry's own posting lag is unmeasured)

confidence_model: Dates are sponsor self-reported (ESTIMATED until completion). The archive proves WHAT the registry showed on WHICH day we looked, nothing about why a date moved. ~42% of dates are month-only. A truncated/failed fetch is refused (diff aborts if the snapshot shrinks below 70% of the previous one; state untouched) so mass 'left_window' cannot be an artifact. No trading claim: the delay-predicts-underperformance hypothesis is pre-registered in open_questions.md and needs >= 52 weeks of accumulation before ladder gate 2.
entity_key: nct (trial) / sponsor (company — ticker join is a gate-2 prerequisite, not done)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest. Append-only JSONL; readers pick field_map from here.
